mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COMTNENTRPRSMBER ( ESNTL_ID , ENTRPRS_MBER_ID , ENTRPRS_SE_CODE , BIZRNO , JURIRNO , CMPNY_NM , CXFC , ZIP , ADRES , ENTRPRS_MIDDLE_TELNO , FXNUM , INDUTY_CODE , APPLCNT_NM , SBSCRB_DE , ENTRPRS_MBER_STTUS , ENTRPRS_MBER_PASSWORD , ENTRPRS_MBER_PASSWORD_HINT , ENTRPRS_MBER_PASSWORD_CNSR , GROUP_ID , DETAIL_ADRES , ENTRPRS_END_TELNO , AREA_NO , APPLCNT_EMAIL_ADRES , APPLCNT_IHIDNUM , CHG_PWD_LAST_PNTTM , MARKETING_YN , AUTH_TY , AUTH_DN , AUTH_CI , AUTH_DI , AUTH_EMAIL , BIZ_REG_FILE_PATH ) VALUES ( #{uniqId}, #{entrprsmberId}, #{entrprsSeCode}, #{bizrno}, #{jurirno}, #{cmpnyNm}, #{cxfc}, #{zip}, #{adres}, #{entrprsMiddleTelno}, #{fxnum}, #{indutyCode}, #{applcntNm}, SYSDATETIME, #{entrprsMberSttus}, #{entrprsMberPassword}, #{entrprsMberPasswordHint}, #{entrprsMberPasswordCnsr}, #{groupId}, #{detailAdres}, #{entrprsEndTelno}, #{areaNo}, #{applcntEmailAdres}, #{applcntIhidnum}, SYSDATETIME, #{marketingYn}, #{authTy}, #{authDn}, #{authCi}, #{authDi}, #{authEmail} , #{bizRegFilePath} )
mapper.select: SELECT ESNTL_ID uniqId, 'USR02' userTy, ENTRPRS_MBER_ID entrprsmberId, ENTRPRS_SE_CODE entrprsSeCode, BIZRNO bizrno, JURIRNO jurirno, CMPNY_NM cmpnyNm, CXFC cxfc, ZIP zip, ADRES adres, ENTRPRS_MIDDLE_TELNO entrprsMiddleTelno, FXNUM fxnum, INDUTY_CODE indutyCode, APPLCNT_NM applcntNm, SBSCRB_DE sbscrbDe, ENTRPRS_MBER_STTUS entrprsMberSttus, ENTRPRS_MBER_PASSWORD entrprsMberPassword, ENTRPRS_MBER_PASSWORD_HINT entrprsMberPasswordHint, ENTRPRS_MBER_PASSWORD_CNSR entrprsMberPasswordCnsr, GROUP_ID groupId, DETAIL_ADRES detailAdres, ENTRPRS_END_TELNO entrprsEndTelno, AREA_NO areaNo, APPLCNT_IHIDNUM applcntIhidnum, APPLCNT_EMAIL_ADRES applcntEmailAdres, MARKETING_YN marketingYn, AUTH_TY authTy, AUTH_DN authDn, AUTH_CI authCi, AUTH_DI authDi, AUTH_EMAIL authEmail, BIZ_REG_FILE_PATH bizRegFilePath, LOCK_AT lockAt FROM COMTNENTRPRSMBER WHERE ESNTL_ID=#{uniqId}
mapper.update: UPDATE COMTNENTRPRSMBER SET ENTRPRS_MBER_ID = #{entrprsmberId}, ENTRPRS_SE_CODE = #{entrprsSeCode}, BIZRNO = #{bizrno}, JURIRNO = #{jurirno}, CMPNY_NM = #{cmpnyNm}, CXFC = #{cxfc}, ZIP = #{zip}, ADRES = #{adres}, ENTRPRS_MIDDLE_TELNO = #{entrprsMiddleTelno}, FXNUM = #{fxnum}, INDUTY_CODE = #{indutyCode}, APPLCNT_NM = #{applcntNm}, ENTRPRS_MBER_STTUS = #{entrprsMberSttus}, ENTRPRS_MBER_PASSWORD_HINT = #{entrprsMberPasswordHint}, ENTRPRS_MBER_PASSWORD_CNSR = #{entrprsMberPasswordCnsr}, GROUP_ID = #{groupId}, DETAIL_ADRES = #{detailAdres}, ENTRPRS_END_TELNO = #{entrprsEndTelno}, AREA_NO = #{areaNo}, APPLCNT_EMAIL_ADRES = #{applcntEmailAdres}, MARKETING_YN = #{marketingYn}, AUTH_TY = #{authTy}, AUTH_DN = #{authDn}, AUTH_CI = #{authCi}, AUTH_DI = #{authDi}, AUTH_EMAIL = #{authEmail}, BIZ_REG_FILE_PATH = #{bizRegFilePath} WHERE ESNTL_ID=#{uniqId}
mapper.select: SELECT USE_STPLAT_ID , USE_STPLAT_CN , INFO_PROVD_AGRE_CN FROM COMTNSTPLATINFO WHERE USE_STPLAT_ID=#{stplatId}
SELECT ENTRPRS_MBER_PASSWORD entrprsMberPassword FROM COMTNENTRPRSMBER WHERE ESNTL_ID=#{uniqId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COMTNINSTTINFO ( INSTT_ID, INSTT_NM, REPRSNT_NM, BIZRNO, ZIP, ADRES, DETAIL_ADRES, BIZ_REG_FILE_PATH, INSTT_STTUS, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM ) VALUES ( #{insttId}, #{insttNm}, #{reprsntNm}, #{bizrno}, #{zip}, #{adres}, #{detailAdres}, #{bizRegFilePath}, 'P', SYSDATETIME, SYSDATETIME )
mapper.select: SELECT INSTT_NM as CMPNY_NM, BIZRNO as BIZRNO, REPRSNT_NM as CXFC FROM COMTNINSTTINFO WHERE (INSTT_NM LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%' OR BIZRNO LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%') AND INSTT_STTUS IN ('P', 'A') UNION ALL SELECT CMPNY_NM as CMPNY_NM, BIZRNO as BIZRNO, CXFC as CXFC FROM COMTNENTRPRSMBER WHERE (CMPNY_NM LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%' OR BIZRNO LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%') AND ENTRPRS_MBER_STTUS IN ('P', 'A') AND BIZRNO NOT IN (SELECT BIZRNO FROM COMTNINSTTINFO) ORDER BY CMPNY_NM ASC

SELECT COUNT(1) totcnt FROM COMTNENTRPRSMBER WHERE 1=1
AND ENTRPRS_MBER_STTUS LIKE #{sbscrbSttus}
AND ENTRPRS_MBER_ID LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%'
AND APPLCNT_NM LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%'
mapper.update: UPDATE COMTNENTRPRSMBER SET LOCK_AT = NULL , LOCK_CNT = NULL , LOCK_LAST_PNTTM = NULL WHERE ESNTL_ID = #{uniqId}
